name: react-native-nitro-dns
description: Blazing-fast Node.js `dns` for React Native. Built with Nitro (JSI) & Rust, supporting DoH/DoT/DoQ and global native network interception.
author: iwater <iwater@gmail.com>

scripts.one: npm run copy-clib && npm run build
scripts.copy-clib: npm run copy-clib-ios && npm run copy-clib-android && npm run copy-clib-mac
scripts.copy-clib-ios: rm -rf ios/Frameworks/RNDns.xcframework && mkdir -p ios/Frameworks && cp -R rust-bundle/target/xcframework/RNDns.xcframework ios/Frameworks/
scripts.copy-clib-android: mkdir -p android/libs/arm64-v8a android/libs/armeabi-v7a android/libs/x86 android/libs/x86_64 && cp rust-bundle/target/aarch64-linux-android/release/librust_c_dns.so android/libs/arm64-v8a/ && cp rust-bundle/target/armv7-linux-androideabi/release/librust_c_dns.so android/libs/armeabi-v7a/ && cp rust-bundle/target/i686-linux-android/release/librust_c_dns.so android/libs/x86/ && cp rust-bundle/target/x86_64-linux-android/release/librust_c_dns.so android/libs/x86_64/ && cp rust-bundle/include/dns_ffi.h cpp/
scripts.copy-clib-mac: mkdir -p mac && cp rust-bundle/target/release/librust_c_dns.a mac/ && cp rust-bundle/include/dns_ffi.h cpp/
